name: Uber Technologies
thesis: Global mobility + delivery marketplace with structural compounding from trip frequency, cross-sell into membership (Uber One), and operating leverage on a now-profitable cost base. Asset-light take-rate × gross-bookings business with widening adj. EBITDA margins and rising FCF conversion. STUB — needs user review.
key_driver: Monthly Active Platform Consumers (MAPCs) × trips/MAPC × take-rate × segment mix (Mobility vs Delivery vs Freight)

tier_1_kpis.name: Monthly Active Platform Consumers (MAPCs) YoY growth
Adjusted EBITDA margin (% of gross bookings)
tier_1_kpis.break_condition: Adj. EBITDA / gross bookings stops expanding YoY for 2 consecutive Qs

tier_1_kpis.name: Free cash flow margin (FCF / revenue, GAAP)

tier_2_kpis.name: Mobility take-rate (Mobility revenue / Mobility gross bookings)
Delivery take-rate (Delivery revenue / Delivery gross bookings)

thesis_breakers_qualitative: Autonomous disintermediation (Waymo / Tesla taking dense urban markets)
Driver-classification ruling forcing W-2 in core US states (CA-style spread)
Take-rate compression from regulator caps or competitive intensity
Insurance cost inflation outrunning pricing power

break_rules.narrative: Revenue declining YoY for 2 consecutive quarters — outright top-line contraction.
FCF margin below 5% for 2 consecutive Qs — cash conversion broken. (Universal floor; per-ticker rules below are stricter.)
Operating cash flow declining >10% YoY for 2 consecutive Qs.

bear_deltas.note: AV-disintermediation + regulatory bear (2026-07 red team): Waymo/Tesla take dense urban markets, take-rate caps + W-2 reclassification spread, insurance inflation outruns pricing - growth -6pp, margin -5pp, exit -4 turns, terminal g -0.5pp. Implied bear FV ~$45/sh vs ~$74.5 live (-39%). Pending owner review.

segments.name: Mobility
segments.description: Ride-hailing globally (UberX, comfort, premium, taxi partnerships).

segments.name: Delivery
segments.description: Uber Eats food + grocery/retail delivery, plus advertising.

segments.name: Freight
segments.description: Logistics marketplace connecting shippers and carriers; sub-scale, lower-margin.

business_model_rules.narrative: Trips YoY < 8% for 2Q — core volume metric stalling. Uber has been compounding trips ~15-20% post-COVID; sub-8% means frequency growth and MAPC adds are both decelerating.
Gross bookings cc < 10% for 2Q — the volume × take-rate compounding thesis breaks. Mid-teens is the structural normal.

business_model_rules.kpi_name: Adjusted EBITDA margin (% of gross bookings)
business_model_rules.narrative: Adj. EBITDA / gross bookings < 4.0% for 2Q — operating leverage thesis breaks. Mgmt guides toward continued YoY margin expansion off the ~3.5-4.0% bar; failure to grind higher signals competitive intensity, insurance pressure, or growth-investment overflow.

business_model_rules.kpi_name: Free cash flow margin (FCF / revenue, GAAP)
business_model_rules.narrative: FCF margin < 15% (FCF / revenue) for 2Q — Uber's structural FCF conversion is high-teens once insurance + working-capital normalize; sub-15 means investment cycle is consuming the operating leverage.
